description: CHC, 2005 June regular phase: 51 of 51 selections from MLB's draft feed (historical importer).

coverage_claims.gap_notes: MLB's draft feed lists 51 selection(s) for the club in the June regular phase. Independent count: 51 (Baseball-Reference franchise-year page, Internet Archive capture 20180423170717: 51 listed, 51 matched to MLB's picks by name (5 by surname in the same round: #340 MLB "Michael Phelps" / "Mike Phelps"; #880 MLB "John Defendis" / "Johnny Defendis"; #1120 MLB "Jesse Keen" / "Kyle Keen"; #1238 MLB "Christopher Rollins" / "Chris Rollins"; #1296 MLB "Mike Brenly" / "Michael Brenly")). Signing status, bonuses and outcomes not researched.
